title: GPT-4 agents run an end-to-end chemical synthesis workflow
summary: Six GPT-4-based agents (literature, experiment design, hardware, spectra, separation, interpretation) ran a Cu/TEMPO aerobic oxidation workflow with automated hardware and were validated on three further reactions. The abstract gives no yields or timings; full text not read.

evidence.tested: Six GPT-4-based agents ran an end-to-end Cu/TEMPO aerobic oxidation workflow with automated hardware, and the framework was validated on three further reactions.
